title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 6: Solomon builds Yahweh's house with cedar, gold and two great cherubim.

questions.text: In which year of Solomon's reign did he begin to build Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: He began to build Yahweh's house in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Ziv.

questions.text: What was the length of the house Solomon built for Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The house had a length of sixty cubits, a width of twenty, and a height of thirty cubits.

questions.text: What was not heard in the house while it was being built?
questions.explanation: The house was built of stone prepared at the quarry, and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in it.

answers.text: Any hammer, ax or tool of iron

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise if Solomon walked in his statutes?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that if Solomon kept his commandments, he would dwell among the children of Israel and not forsake his people.

answers.text: To give Solomon victory over Egypt
To double the size of the house
To dwell among Israel and not forsake them

questions.text: According to 1 Kings 6:18, what could not be seen inside the house?
questions.explanation: Inside the house there was cedar carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar; no stone was visible.

questions.text: Why did Solomon prepare the inner sanctuary in the middle of the house?
questions.explanation: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house to set the ark of Yahweh's covenant there.

answers.text: To set the ark of Yahweh's covenant there

questions.text: What were the measurements of the inner sanctuary?
questions.explanation: Within, the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, twenty in width and twenty in height, overlaid with pure gold.

answers.text: Ten cubits long, wide and high
Thirty cubits long, wide and high
Forty long, twenty wide, ten high
Twenty cubits long, wide and high

questions.text: Of what wood were the two cherubim in the inner sanctuary made?
questions.explanation: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

questions.text: What figures were carved on all the walls of the house?
questions.explanation: He carved all the walls of the house with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.

answers.text: Cherubim, palm trees and open flowers
The sun, the moon and the stars

questions.text: How long did Solomon spend building the house?
questions.explanation: The house was finished in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, so he spent seven years building it.
